title: PROGMEM, F(), and flash memory

spans.text: On AVR boards such as the UNO, `PROGMEM` can keep large constant tables in flash instead of scarce SRAM; `pgm_read_byte()` and `pgm_read_word()` read them. `F("...")` passes a string literal to functions such as `Serial.print` without copying it into RAM, where supported. This can save memory on small boards.

spans.title: Important note
spans.text: This is platform-specific. Guard AVR code with `ARDUINO_ARCH_AVR`; ESP32 maps flash differently, so do not use AVR read helpers there. Check that the library or `Print` overload supports flash strings.
